english.title: Possess to show / distribute - indecent photograph / pseudo-photograph of a child
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession

(A)_[an indecent photograph, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REFERENCE NO. (AND/OR EXHIBIT NO.) OF THE IMAGE THE CHARGE REFERS TO ON THE MG6, IF POSSIBLE!..),]_
(B)_[indecent photographs, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REFERENCE NO. (AND/OR EXHIBIT NO.) OF THE IMAGE THE CHARGE REFERS TO ON THE MG6, IF POSSIBLE!..),]_
(C)_[an indecent pseudo-photograph, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REFERENCE NO. (AND/OR EXHIBIT NO.) OF THE IMAGE THE CHARGE REFERS TO ON THE MG6, IF POSSIBLE!..),]_
(D)_[indecent pseudo-photographs, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REFERENCE NO. (AND/OR EXHIBIT NO.) OF THE IMAGE THE CHARGE REFERS TO ON THE MG6, IF POSSIBLE!..),]_

of

(E)_[a child]_
(F)_[children]_

with a view to

(G)_[its]_
(H)_[their]_

being distributed or shown by you or another
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1(1)(c) and 6 of the Protection of Children Act 1978.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
possessed indecent photograph(s)/pseudo-photograph(s)
of child/children with a view to it/them being distributed/shown to another

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Please refer to the extensive Notes in relation to this offence which are attached to the legal topic document covering section 1 of the Protection of Children Act 1978.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
